`abstract class UIChangeEvent<U extends UI, V>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIEvent<U>`](/reference/events/uievent/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`UIChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-pre/), [`UIChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-post/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIChangeEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UIChangeEvent.java)

The change of a value of a UI, with the value before and the value after, in a cancellable `Pre` and a `Post`.

## Description

[`UI.beforeZoom`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-method-beforeZoom) receives a [`UIChangeEvent.Pre`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-pre/) and can refuse a new zoom; [`UI.onZoom`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-event-onZoom) receives a [`UIChangeEvent.Post`](/reference/events/uichangeevent-post/) once the zoom changed.
